Running it
----------
This is for a Tatung Einstein 256 (or an emulator of one) with its disk
DOS, which is CP/M compatible.

  simcity.dsk     a disk image with the four game files on it:
                  SIMCITY.COM, SIMCITY.GAM, SIMCITY.MOD, SIMCITY.SND
                  and TILES.DAT.  The image has no DOS on it: boot the
                  DOS from its own disk, then change to the drive that
                  has this one (or copy the files to a DOS disk).

Type SIMCITY.  All the files must be on the same disk.

SIMCITY.COM is the program.  It reads SIMCITY.GAM and SIMCITY.MOD, the
game's screens, and SIMCITY.SND, the sound effects, and keeps them in the
video RAM, and it draws from TILES.DAT, the pictures.  The game uses
screen 5 of the V9938 (256 x 192, 16 colours), the AY-3-8910 for the
sound effects, and the keyboard.  Cities are saved to and loaded from DOS
files (names of up to eight letters).  There is no way out of the game
but resetting the machine.

Keys
----
  O P Q A         left, right, up, down
  Space, Enter    build with the tool
  , .             the previous and next tool
  0 - 9           choose a tool by its number
  H               pause or run
  + -             faster, slower
  M               the next mini map (X goes back to the city)
  B               the budget            V   the evaluation
  S               save the city         L   load a city
  X               the game menu: new city, options, disasters, sound
  Esc             leaves a screen and opens the game menu
